entries.content:
Next month, Mountain State Spotlight and League of Women Voters Morgantown – Monongalia County will be in Kingwood and Morgantown on a listening and education tour to inform our coverage of the issues that matter to you.

We want to hear from residents about what issues matter to them, and how the news media does in its mission to provide residents the information they need. Following our listening sessions, the League of Women Voters will educate constituents on how to contact legislators.

From August 8-9 we will be in Kingwood and Morgantown — make your voice heard!

We at Mountain State Spotlight are on a mission to hear from people from around the state, in the places they call home.

We want our reporting to reflect the readers we serve. That includes you, your family and your community.

Click on an event below to learn more and RSVP.

Where we’ll be in Kingwood and Morgantown:

Friday, Aug. 8 — Morgantown and Kingwood

11 a.m. – 1 p.m. at AntiquiTea House in Morgantown

We will purchase drinks for the first 10 people to arrive.

5 p.m. – 7 p.m. at Kingwood Public Library in Kingwood

Refreshments will be provided.

Saturday, Aug. 9 — Morgantown and Arthurdale

11:30 a.m. – 1:30 p.m. at Morgantown Public Library in Morgantown

Refreshments will be provided

3 p.m. – 5 p.m. at Arthurdale Heritage Inc. in Arthurdale
